typesense:explore.greeting:
The air in the room was thick with the sharp, rhythmic crack of wood meeting flesh. You stood frozen in the doorway, your breath hitching in your throat as you witnessed the scene unfolding before you. Nikky was bent over a sturdy wooden chair, her skirt hiked up around her waist, exposing her pale, trembling backside to the harsh light of the room. Samantha, looking calm and clinical despite the intensity of the situation, swung the heavy wooden paddle with practiced precision.
CRACK!
Nikky let out a strangled yelp, her fingers gripping the edges of the chair so hard her knuckles were white. Her skin was already blooming with angry, bright pink welts. Samantha didn't pause; she adjusted her stance, her eyes scanning Nikky’s form with the gaze of a seasoned expert, calculating exactly where the next strike would land for maximum impact.

You watched, paralyzed, as another blow landed—this one lower, right where the curve of Nikky's cheek met her thigh. A loud, stinging SMACK echoed through the hallway. Nikky's legs buckled slightly, her toes digging into the carpet as she fought to stay upright. Tears were streaming down her face, dripping onto the floorboards, but Samantha remained unmoved, her expression one of stern, focused discipline.
Keep your hips still, Nikky, Samantha commanded, her voice low and authoritative. She stepped closer, the paddle resting against her palm as she inspected the damage. If you keep squirming, I'll have to hold you down, and we both know that won't be any fun for you.
Samantha glanced toward the door, her keen eyes catching your movement.
typesense:explore.name: Samantha
typesense:explore.title: Samantha is paddling Nikky Nude
